title: GEmote
body:
![GEmote logo](https://i.imgur.com/xQ92fdq.png)

# <center>**Modern lightweight particle emote - plugin**</center>

### <center>**Supports Spigot, Paper (+ all Forks), Folia Servers from 1.13 to 26.2!**</center>


**Overview**


* **This is a modern lightweight emote - plugin which allows you to use multiple emotes**
* This Plugin contains a lot of settings and features that all can be changed by you in the plugin config and the language files



* Join the [**GPlugins Discord Server**](https://discord.gg/Cy2P4AU) for the latest **Updates** and **News**
* If you like my plugins and libraries please support me by leaving a good [**Review**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/114073/rate?rating=5)



**Special Features**


* **100% customizable!**
* Very good performance
* **WorldGuard**-Area-**Support**!
* WorldGuard-Flags! ("emote")
* Placeholders from **PlaceholderAPI** ("emoting")
* **And many more ...**


**More emotes**


* You can create new emotes by making a copy of an existing emote
* Edit it with a text editor to change the content
* The file structure is explained in the file



* [You like to download already existing files? Visit our **emotes** Discord channel!](https://discord.gg/Cy2P4AU)

**Commands**

**/emote (/gemote)** -> Use an emote

**/gemotereload (/gemoterl)** -> Reloads the plugin


**Permissions**


**OP-Permission**: GEmote.*
**Update-Notification-Permission:** GEmote.Update
**Config-Reload-Permission:** GEmote.Reload

**Emote-Permissions** (Default permissions marked underlined)**:**

* **GEmote.Emote.*** -> Combines "GEmote.Emote & GEmote.Emote.[Name]"
* **GEmote.Emote** -> Use "/emote"
* **GEmote.Emote.[Name]** -> Use "/emote [Name]"
* **GEmote.ByPass.*** -> Combines "GEmote.ByPass.World"
* **GEmote.ByPass.World** -> Ignore the WorldBlacklist
* **GEmote.ByPass.Region** -> Ignore regions


**Known Bugs / Issues**

If you discover any kind of bug please join the [**GPlugins Discord Server**](https://discord.gg/Cy2P4AU), so i can fix it as soon as possible!


**Stats**

[![https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/GEmote.svg](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/GEmote.svg)](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/gemote)

**This Plugin supports the Minecraft-Versions:**
**1.13, 1.14, 1.15, 1.16, 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.20, 1.21, 26.1 & 26.2**
